name: dimi-skills
description: Dimi's Claude Code plugin: a reviewer-grade development loop with hooks and agents, and forward-deployed engineering for LLM agents. Also lists three third-party companion plugins (ponytail, pstack, cursor-team-kit) so they install from here.

plugins.name: dimi
plugins.description: Dimi's engineering toolkit for Claude Code. A reviewer-grade development loop (plan from a ticket, state-complete UI, pre-commit self-review, ship, address review, compound learnings into rules) with hooks and agents, plus forward-deployed engineering for LLM agents (harness reference, production-readiness review, MCP hardening, client profiles, fact refresh).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Companion (third party, MIT, by Dietrich Gebert): the lazy-senior-dev stance for writing code. Climb a ladder (does it need to exist, is it already here, standard library, platform, installed dependency, one line, then the minimum), never cut validation, data-loss handling, security or accessibility, one small test for risky logic, a shortcut: marker with a debt ledger, and a diff review that reads the code around the diff. Installed from its own repository; dimi does not maintain it.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Companion (third party, MIT, by Cursor): playbook-routed agent workflows. /pstack:poteto-mode takes a goal and a checkable done condition and runs the right playbook (investigation, bug fix, feature, refactor, perf, overnight runs) with evidence, plus named principles to steer with, a decision log, unslop, no-comments, tdd and a benchmark checklist. Installed from the Claude Code build inside cursor/plugins; dimi does not maintain it.

plugins.name: cursor-team-kit
plugins.description: Companion (third party, MIT, by Cursor): team workflow skills, among them thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review (an unusually strict maintainability review: code-judo simplifications, branching growth, files past 1,000 lines, thin wrappers, casts, logic in the wrong layer), deslop, verify-this, fix-ci, loop-on-ci, review-and-ship, make-pr-easy-to-review, what-did-i-get-done and weekly-review. Written for Cursor; it has no Claude Code manifest, so Claude Code loads its skills/ and agents/ directly and ignores its Cursor rules. dimi does not maintain it.
